data.title: GAP - ProjectListView has no source event on this timeline

meta.title: RESOLVED - ProjectListView now sourced from Create Project chapter
meta.description:
## Resolved

The 'Create Project' chapter (timeline bb4f520b-d356-44cb-beff-86a59e23d021) now models project creation: a CreateProject command produces a ProjectCreated event. That event has been replayed onto this timeline as node 2aad4f6b-8b06-4de1-8e89-5a00c186fa6d (linked copy) and wired to ProjectListView, so ProjectListView.projectId/shorthand/name now trace to a real source event.
